channel.title: Web3 Hub
channel.description: Web3 Hub reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, exchanges, DeFi protocols, stablecoins, regulation, security incidents and network upgrades.

item.title: A Crypto Treasury Exit Plan Starts Before the Drawdown
item.description: A drawdown exit plan starts with a cash runway, staged withdrawal rules and a check on what liquidity pools will return—not the token balance shown on screen.

item.title: How DeFi Tax Recordkeeping Tracks Swaps, Fees and Rewards
item.description: DeFi tax records tie wallet actions to token amounts, fees, market values and evidence, helping users reconcile swaps, rewards and liquidity activity before filing.

item.title: New Pair Pools: Check Liquidity Before You Trade
item.description: New pair pools can offer early access to a token, but shallow liquidity magnifies price impact; compare depth, route costs and token controls before trading.

item.title: TRON ABI decoding adds Energy through contract execution
item.description: ABI decoding uses TRON Energy when contract code processes data on-chain; client-side decoding uses no execution Energy, and estimates help size calls.

item.title: How to Withdraw Liquidity Pool Tokens Into USDT
item.description: Redeem LP tokens for the pool’s assets, swap the non-USDT side, and check fees, slippage and the receiving network before sending funds to a wallet.

item.title: Cross-chain swaps through TRON: how settlement works
item.description: A cross-chain swap routed through TRON ends with a transaction on the TRON network; learn how bridges, wallet addresses and USDT fees shape settlement.

item.title: Monero payout teams need a wallet-linked reconciliation ledger
item.description: Monero payout reconciliation pairs each invoice with a wallet-detected receipt, then tracks confirmations and outgoing transfers in a controlled internal ledger.

item.title: XMR bridge routes depend on the destination asset and trust model
item.description: An XMR bridge can route Monero into another asset or chain; the right choice depends on the destination, how value moves and who controls the exchange.

item.title: Bridged Treasury Tokens Can Clear Before Fund Shares Do
item.description: A bridge can move a Treasury fund token in minutes or longer, but destination-chain arrival does not guarantee transfer-agent recognition or cash redemption.

item.title: Byreal: how to swap, add liquidity and join launches
item.description: Byreal combines Solana swaps, concentrated-liquidity positions and token launches; learn how to review quotes, choose a range and check sale terms before committing funds.

item.title: How to spot a large holder selling in steady trading
item.description: Steady price and volume do not rule out a large holder selling; compare wallet balances, pool flows and swap data before reading a market chart as calm.

item.title: Poocoin chart workflow: find the right pair before reading price
item.description: Poocoin can make token checks quicker when traders search by contract, verify the market pair, then read price action alongside liquidity and recent swaps.

item.title: Blockchain.com, NYSE Sign Tokenized Stocks MOU
item.description: Blockchain.com and NYSE signed an MOU on Sept. 23 to route tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs to its users through a planned digital venue, pending approvals.
